title: Missing Unit of Work in Key-Value / Fabric Cache Persistence
pattern: Modifying multiple distinct entries in a key-value store or distributed cache sequentially without a transaction orchestrator (Unit of Work).
why_bad: It forces every single `.put()` operation to act as an individual write transaction across the network, leading to high write latency and leaving the data store in a partially-updated state if one write fails.
detection: Successive calls to a distributed cache's `.put()` or `.set()` method in a loop over a collection, without a wrapping transaction manager or batch write.
counterexample: Writing to a local in-memory thread-safe map.
fix: Use batch operations (e.g. `put_all()`) or a Unit of Work boundary to flush all dirty changes in a single batch transaction.
